Counts above and directory totals use the same filtered files. Directory totals include descendants; expanding a folder does not add files to the total. Renames are listed once at their current path.

Calculation

  • Compares the working tree, including nonignored untracked files, with the selected baseline. Local-folder mode includes that checkout’s nonignored working-tree changes. No boot-closure filter.
  • Git Myers line diff with 50% rename similarity detection; exhaustive matching is limited to 200 candidates. Exact renames are still detected above the limit. Renames below this threshold appear as a deleted file and a new file. Added lines do not establish authorship.
  • Counts physical UTF-8 text lines, including comments and blanks. Normalizes CRLF to LF. A trailing newline does not add an extra line. Binary or non-UTF-8 comparisons have no line counts.
  • Excludes ignored untracked files, symlinks, directories named node_modules, dist, .git, .build, target, gen, icons, .vite, out, package-lock.json, src-tauri/Cargo.lock, this generated report, and HTML reports containing an embedded generated JSON dataset. File permissions are not measured.

Generated entirely by node docs/provenance/build.mjs. Select a baseline with --rev <git-ref> or --upstream <checkout>.
